title: Dataset and computer code for "The dynamics of cooperation in asymmetric public goods games"
question: How do endowment asymmetry and game structure influence contribution dynamics across player groups?
publisher: Wang, Xiaomin (Beijing Normal University); Hilbe, Christian (Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology); Zhang, Boyu (Beijing Normal University)
variables_and_units: contributions, endowments, payoffs and survey responses
validation_design: session and interacting player group Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Complete experimental MAT/XLSX and code packages, two/four-player linear/threshold games with surveys.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Group interacting participants by session/game. Repeated rounds are dependent; payoffs mechanically computed from contributions are not independent discoveries.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

reader_limitations.note: MCOS table object preserved; SciPy decodes opaque object/workspace, not MATLAB table semantics. Source XLSX alternative retained.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
